entries.title: Revelation of John 13:1
segments: ¶And I stood upon the sand of the sea; and I saw a beast rising out of the sea, having ten horns and seven heads, and upon its horns ten diadems, and upon its heads names of blasphemy.

entries.title: Revelation of John 13:2
segments: And the beast which I saw was like to a leopardess, and its feet as of a bear, and its mouth as a lion's mouth; and the dragon gave to it his power, and his throne, and great authority;

entries.title: Revelation of John 13:3
segments: and one of his heads [was] as slain to death, and his wound of death had been healed: and the whole earth wondered after the beast.

entries.title: Revelation of John 13:4
segments: And they did homage to the dragon, because he gave the authority to the beast; and they did homage to the beast, saying, Who [is] like to the beast? and who can make war with it?

entries.title: Revelation of John 13:5
segments: And there was given to it a mouth, speaking great things and blasphemies; and there was given to it authority to pursue its career forty-two months.

entries.title: Revelation of John 13:6
segments: And it opened its mouth for blasphemies against God, to blaspheme his name and his tabernacle, and those who have their tabernacle in the heaven.

entries.title: Revelation of John 13:7
segments: And there was given to it to make war with the saints, and to overcome them; and there was given to it authority over every tribe, and people, and tongue, and nation;

entries.title: Revelation of John 13:8
segments: and all that dwell on the earth shall do it homage, [every one] whose name had not been written from [the] founding of [the] world in the book of life of the slain Lamb.

entries.title: Revelation of John 13:9
segments: If any one has an ear, let him hear.

entries.title: Revelation of John 13:10
segments: If any one [leads] into captivity, he goes into captivity. If any one shall kill with [the] sword, he must with [the] sword be killed. Here is the endurance and the faith of the saints.

entries.title: Revelation of John 13:11
segments: ¶And I saw another beast rising out of the earth; and it had two horns like to a lamb, and spake as a dragon;

entries.title: Revelation of John 13:12
segments: and it exercises all the authority of the first beast before it, and causes the earth and those that dwell in it to do homage to the first beast, whose wound of death was healed.

entries.title: Revelation of John 13:13
segments: And it works great signs, that it should cause even fire to come down from heaven to the earth before men.

entries.title: Revelation of John 13:14
segments: And it deceives those that dwell upon the earth by reason of the signs which it was given to it to work before the beast, saying to those that dwell upon the earth to make an image to the beast, which has the wound of the sword, and lived.

entries.title: Revelation of John 13:15
segments: And it was given to it to give breath to the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should also speak, and should cause that as many as should not do homage to the image of the beast should be killed.

entries.title: Revelation of John 13:16
segments: And it causes all, the small and the great, and the rich and the poor, and the free and the bondmen, that they should give them a mark upon their right hand or upon their forehead;

entries.title: Revelation of John 13:17
segments: and that no one should be able to buy or sell save he that had the mark, the name of the beast, or the number of its name.

entries.title: Revelation of John 13:18
segments: Here is wisdom. He that has understanding let him count the number of the beast: for it is a man's number; and its number [is] six hundred [and] sixty-six.
